title: Native Device MCP resource OAuth and exact device grant impact

phases.objective: Exercise scoped OAuth JWT and JWKS device-resource admission on Local Connector with strict issuer, audience, tenant, environment, device and scope validation; leave live Staging runtime certification outstanding.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Only correctly signed and scoped JWTs may enumerate and invoke explicitly permitted device operations; secrets, unauthorized writes, cross-tenant/device/environment calls and malformed signatures are rejected.
steps: Provide a JWKS signer and JWT with exact issuer, audience, tenant, environment and device claims.
Read allowed tool catalog with a valid read scope and deny local filesystem roots and unauthorized write capabilities.
Reject forged signatures, noncanonical Base64URL encoding and cross-identity or expired claims.
Confirm mutation scopes remain separate from read permissions.
assertions: JWT signature and canonical Base64URL checks fail closed.
Tool and resource access is bound to exact device, tenant, environment and scope.
No read-only caller gains mutation permissions or local secret paths.
Live Staging OAuth and Connector integration remain unverified by synthetic contract tests.
